overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（4 篇）、劳动经济学（1 篇）。方法上以面板数据、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（10 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: Inverse Learning of Latent Risk-Neutral Densities from Irregular Option Quotes
papers.abstract: Accurate option prices do not imply accurate recovery of the latent risk-neutral density. We study this distinction with two complementary benchmarks. A controlled benchmark exposes simulator-truth densities for latent evaluation, while a chronological NIFTY benchmark tests only held-out market prices. A two-component lognormal mixture has the lowest aggregate price, $L^1$, Wasserstein, and fixed-tail errors on the synthetic benchmark. Learned operators retain narrower strengths: DeepONet reduces 1% quantile and variance error by 39.0% and 34.6% relative to the mixture, and a quote transformer reduces $L^1$ by 16.4% on the structurally misspecified Merton family. A numerical conditioning analysis explains why these rankings can differ: after enforcing mass and forward constraints, 95 of 126 pricing directions are numerically null, and two densities separated by $L^1 = 0.061$ produce identical prices on the covered strikes. On 524 held-out NIFTY calls, validation-selected test-time adaptation reduces DeepONet RMSE by 28.3%, but per-expiry mixture and SVI fits remain much more accurate. The evidence supports target-dependent inductive bias, not a universal winner.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】准确的期权价格并不意味着能够精确地还原潜在的风险中性密度分布。我们通过两个互补的基准测试来研究这一差异：一个受控基准测试用于评估模拟器生成的真实密度分布，而另一个基于历史数据的NIFTY基准测试仅使用未预测的市场价格数据。在合成基准测试中，双组分对数正态混合模型在总体价格（L^1距离）、Wasserstein距离以及固定尾部误差方面表现最佳。经过训练的模型模型在性能上仍具有显著优势：DeepONet模型将分位数误差降低了1%，方差误差降低了39.0%；Quote Transformer模型在结构设定不准确的Merton模型家族中，将L^1距离降低了16.4%。数值条件分析揭示了这些排名差异的原因：在施加质量约束和未来价格约束后，126个定价方向中有95个在数值上不存在差异；两个L^1距离为0.061的密度分布在对冲执行价格上产生了相同的结果。在524个未预测的NIFTY看涨期权案例中，经过验证后选定的模型在测试阶段的适应性调整使DeepONet的均方根误差（RMSE）降低了28.3%，但基于混合模型的定价方法和SVI模型仍具有更高的准确性。研究结果表明，这些模型的表现依赖于具体应...。研究方法：Transformer 模型。

papers.title: How Divorce Reforms Induced Married Couples to Supply More Labor
papers.abstract: This paper studies the dynamic effects of divorce legislation on the labor supply behavior and welfare of married couples. Using U.S. household panel data, I examine the transition from the "Title-based Regime" (TBR) in the 1970s to the "Equitable Distribution Regime" (EDR) in the 1980s. Under the former regime, marital assets are split based on formal ownership rights, allowing spouses to commit ex ante to a future asset allocation in the event of divorce. The shift to EDR, where courts more equitably divide marital assets, interacted in two ways with household uncertainty. First, because the court chooses the division of assets, households can no longer commit to a future asset allocation. Second, because the court's decision is not fully predictable, the policy introduces a new source of uncertainty. For these reasons, EDR increased the incentives for both spouses to self-insure by working to accumulate precautionary savings during marriage. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design, I confirm empirically that both married men and women increased labor supply in response to the policy change, with the women's increase equal to 30% of the total rise in female labor force participation over the last 70 years. To rationalize and understand the welfare implications of the empirical evidence, I develop and estimate a dynamic model of household labor supply, savings, and divorce. I use the estimated model to show that EDR may have inadvertently reduced the welfare of both spouses even while married.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】本文研究了离婚立法对已婚夫妇劳动供给行为和福利的动态影响。利用美国家庭面板数据，我分析了20世纪70年代的“基于产权的财产分配制度”（Title-based Regime，简称TBR）向80年代的“公平分配制度”（Equitable Distribution Regime，简称EDR）的转变。在TBR制度下，婚姻财产根据正式的所有权权利进行分割，使配偶能够在离婚时预先约定未来的财产分配方案。而EDR制度的实施使得法院在财产分配上更加公平，这一变化对家庭面临的不确定性产生了双重影响：首先，由于财产分配由法院决定，家庭无法再预先确定未来的财产分配方案；其次，法院的判决具有不可预测性，从而为家庭带来了新的不确定性来源。基于这些原因，EDR制度增加了配偶在婚姻期间通过工作积累预防性储蓄的动机。通过采用分阶段差异差异（staggered difference-in-differences）研究方法，我实证发现，无论是已婚男性还是女性都因政策变化而增加了劳动供给，其中女性的劳动供给增加幅度相当于过去70年间女性劳动力参与率总增长的30%。为合理解释这些实证结果及其对福利的影响，我构建并估算了...。研究方法：双重差分、面板数据。

papers.title: Determinants of Audit Delay: The Moderating Role of Firm Size in Conventional Commercial Bank in Indonesia and Singapore (2021-2025)
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effects of audit fee, audit committee, and firm age on audit delay, with firm size serving as a moderating variable in conventional commercial banks in Indonesia and Singapore during the 2021–2025 period. A quantitative approach with a causal-associative design was employed. The population consisted of conventional commercial banks listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) and commercial banks operating under the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS). The sample was selected using purposive sampling, and secondary data were collected from audited annual financial statements. Panel data regression analysis was used to test the proposed hypotheses. The findings indicate that audit fee and firm age do not have a significant effect on audit delay. In contrast, the audit committee significantly affects audit delay, suggesting that effective oversight and monitoring contribute to a more timely audit completion process. Simultaneously, audit fee, audit committee, and firm age significantly influence audit delay. The moderation analysis further reveals that firm size moderates the relationship between firm age and audit delay, indicating that larger and more established banks tend to complete audits more efficiently. However, firm size does not moderate the relationships between audit fee and audit delay or between audit committee and audit delay. Overall, the results highlight the importance of audit committee effectiveness and organizational capacity in enhancing audit timeliness within the banking industry.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】本研究探讨了审计费用、审计委员会以及公司规模对审计延迟的影响，其中公司规模在2021至2025年期间作为调节变量，研究对象为印度尼西亚和新加坡的常规商业银行。研究采用了定量方法，并采用了因果关联设计。样本包括在印度尼西亚证券交易所（IDX）上市的常规商业银行以及在新加坡货币管理局（MAS）监管下运营的商业银行。样本通过目的性抽样方法选取，所需数据来自已审计的年度财务报表。研究通过面板数据回归分析来验证提出的假设。研究结果表明，审计费用和公司规模对审计延迟没有显著影响；而审计委员会对审计延迟有显著影响，这说明有效的监督和监控有助于提高审计工作的完成效率。此外，审计费用、审计委员会和公司规模共同对审计延迟产生影响。调节性分析进一步表明，公司规模能够调节公司规模与审计延迟之间的关系，即规模较大、经营较久的银行通常能够更高效地完成审计工作。然而，公司规模并未对审计费用与审计延迟之间的关系或审计委员会与审计延迟之间的关系产生调节作用。总体而言，研究结果强调了审计委员会的有效性以及组织能力在提升银行业审计时效性方面的关键作用。。研究方法：面板数据、回归分析。

papers.title: Systemic Analysis of Gender-Responsive Planning and Budgeting Policies in Kulon Progo Regency
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study examines the structural dynamics of gender-responsive planning and budgeting (GRPB) implementation at the local government level in Kulon Progo Regency, Indonesia. Using a qualitative exploratory design, the research applies MICMAC structural analysis to identify and classify the key indicators shaping GRPB implementation. Data were collected through a literature review, regulatory analysis, and structured stakeholder assessments involving planning agencies, sectoral offices, and gender focal points. The analysis maps direct and indirect influence–dependence relationships to understand the systemic structure of gender-responsive governance. The findings indicate that the regulatory environment, policy consistency, and leadership commitment function as the primary driving factors determining the direction and stability of GRPB implementation. Institutional capacity, women’s participation, economic policy orientation, and inter-organizational coordination act as linkage factors that transmit influence throughout the system, while the integration of gender perspectives into planning and budgeting, together with monitoring and evaluation mechanisms, represents outcome indicators shaped by broader institutional dynamics. These results suggest that effective GRPB implementation depends more on strong institutional coherence than on isolated technical actions. Although the study is limited to a single district and relies on stakeholder perceptions, it offers a systemic framework for strengthening institutional governance in gender-responsive fiscal policy. By adopting a systems-based perspective, this research contributes to the literature on subnational gender budgeting and provides insights for improving the institutional design of gender-responsive governance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了印度尼西亚库隆普罗戈县（Kulon Progo Regency）地方政府层面性别响应型规划与预算编制（Gender-Responsive Planning and Budgeting, GRPB）实施过程中的结构动态。采用定性探索性研究方法，研究者运用MICMAC结构分析工具来识别和分类影响GRPB实施的关键指标。数据来源包括文献回顾、法规分析以及与规划机构、部门办公室和性别问题协调部门进行的结构化利益相关者评估。通过分析这些数据，研究者揭示了直接和间接的影响-依赖关系，从而理解性别响应型治理的系统性框架。研究结果表明，监管环境、政策连贯性以及领导层的承诺是决定GRPB实施方向和稳定性的主要驱动因素；机构能力、女性参与度、经济政策导向以及组织间的协调作用则是在整个系统中传递影响力的关键因素。此外，将性别视角融入规划与预算编制过程中，并建立相应的监测与评估机制，这些因素共同构成了受更广泛制度动态影响的结果指标。研究结果表明，有效的GRPB实施更多地依赖于制度层面的协同性，而非孤立的技术性措施。尽管本研究仅针对单一地区展开，并基于利益相关者的观点，但它为加强性别响应型财政...。

papers.title: Rainfall is rough
papers.abstract: We propose a new approach to model rainfall by combining heterogeneous data sources at different time scales. Continuous arrivals of rain cells are incorporated into a Hawkes process formalism that encompasses the classical Bartlett-Lewis and Neyman-Scott models, thereby providing a more flexible representation of clustering. Analysis of high frequency rainfall data (at the minute scale over several years) indicates that critical Hawkes processes with heavy-tailed power-law kernels yield a superior fit relative to classical models and alternative kernel specifications. Scaling arguments inspired by Jaisson and Rosenbaum (2016) imply that aggregated rainfall at coarse time scales converges to a rough fractional process with Hurst exponent close to zero. This prediction is supported by empirical evidence from low-frequency data (annual observations spanning centuries to millennia), where the Hurst exponent is estimated to lie between 0.01 and 0.1 based on either direct observations from weather stations or proxy reconstructions such as tree-ring records. These results establish a connection between rainfall dynamics and models developed in quantitative finance for market microstructure and volatility. They also provide a new perspective on classical scaling phenomena originally studied by Hurst and Mandelbrot.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种新的方法来模拟降雨过程，该方法结合了不同时间尺度上的异构数据源。连续出现的雨滴被纳入霍克斯过程（Hawkes process）框架中，该框架涵盖了经典的巴特利特-刘易斯（Bartlett-Lewis）模型和内曼-斯科特（Neyman-Scott）模型，从而实现了对降雨聚集现象的更灵活描述。对多年高频降雨数据（以分钟为时间尺度）的分析表明，具有重尾幂律核函数的关键霍克斯过程相较于经典模型及其他核函数规格，能够提供更优的拟合效果。受Jaisson和Rosenbaum（2016年）研究的启发，我们发现粗时间尺度上的降雨总量会收敛为一个具有接近零的赫斯特指数（Hurst exponent）的分数过程。这一预测得到了低频数据（涵盖数百年至数千年的年度观测数据）的实证支持：根据气象站的直接观测结果或树木年轮记录等替代重建方法，估计的赫斯特指数介于0.01到0.1之间。这些发现揭示了降雨动态与量化金融领域中用于描述市场微观结构和波动性的模型之间的联系，同时也为赫斯特（Hurst）和曼德布罗特（Mandelbrot）最初研究的经典标度现象提供了新的视角。。

papers.title: Where does the criticality live? Early-warning signals are event-heterogeneous across seven crypto-perpetual liquidation cascades
papers.abstract: Do crypto perpetual-futures crashes carry a reproducible early-warning fingerprint of a critical transition, and in which state variable? We study seven major BTC liquidation cascades (2022-2025, including the record 19B USD event of 10 October 2025) using minute-level price and 5-minute leverage/order-flow data. On detrended residuals we compute rolling variance and lag-1 autocorrelation and test their pre-cascade trend with the Kendall-tau statistic, sweeping 39 analysis configurations per variable per event. No variable is event-invariant. Price carries the critical-slowing-down signature in five of seven events but is silent in exactly the two sudden-news (tariff) shocks, suggesting a two-type structure: endogenous-buildup versus exogenous-shock cascades. The October 2025 event, whose in-sample analysis suggests the signature lives in leverage rather than price, turns out to be the outlier, not the rule. The one regularity surviving all events with data is a compression of taker order-flow variance, which passes a 300-onset placebo test (Fisher-combined p ~ 5e-6) but is a population-level precursor, not a per-event alarm. Single-event critical-slowing-down claims in crypto derivatives are therefore fragile by construction. We argue the pattern of failures is itself diagnostic: slowing down is absent exactly where the destabilising mechanism is most abrupt, as one would expect if these cascades are discontinuous, shock-driven transitions rather than critical ones.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】加密货币永续期货的崩盘是否具有可复制的早期预警特征，这些特征能否反映某种关键性的市场转变？我们研究了七次主要的比特币清算事件（2022年至2025年期间，包括2025年10月10日发生的创纪录的190亿美元清算事件），使用了分钟级别的价格数据以及5分钟间隔的杠杆率和订单流数据。在对价格数据进行去趋势处理后，我们计算了滚动方差和滞后1期的自相关性，并利用肯德尔-陶氏统计量（Kendall-tau statistic）来检验这些特征在事件发生前的变化趋势，每种变量每种事件共进行了39种分析组合。结果表明，没有任何一个变量在所有事件中都保持不变。在七次事件中有五次，价格数据呈现出市场放缓的关键特征；但在两次由突发新闻（如关税政策）引发的冲击事件中，价格数据并未显示出这种变化，这表明市场崩溃过程存在两种不同的类型：一种是市场内部因素逐渐累积导致的，另一种则是外部冲击引发的。2025年10月的事件虽然也出现了市场放缓的特征，但进一步分析发现这种特征主要体现在杠杆率变化上，而非价格变动上，因此该事件属于异常情况，而非普遍规律。唯一在所有事件中都存在的一致性现象是订单流方差的压缩现象，这一现象...。

papers.title: Herding, Momentum, and Reversal in China's A-Share Market: An Agent-Based Network Model with Information Diffusion
papers.abstract: This study develops an agent-based financial market model to explain stock-price momentum and reversal through the joint effects of local herding and delayed information diffusion. Investors form heterogeneous Gaussian beliefs about the next-period price, choose among buying, selling, and remaining inactive, and revise their action probabilities in response to neighboring investors. The local interaction structure is represented by von Neumann and Moore lattices and is later replaced by Erdős--Rényi and Watts--Strogatz networks for robustness. A separate information process updates investor beliefs through a finite-speed diffusion mechanism, allowing informational adjustment to be distinguished from behavioral imitation. The simulations show that stronger herding produces spatially clustered trading, larger price fluctuations, and more pronounced excess kurtosis in returns. Faster information diffusion reduces the time required for prices to approach the signal-implied value, whereas the combination of information diffusion and social reinforcement generates overshooting and subsequent reversal. An empirical application to China's A-share market compares conventional CSAD and LSV measures with a rolling tail-based herding indicator obtained after Johnson $S_U$ transformation. The indicators display similar time variation and rise during major market disruptions. These findings identify information delay, local social reinforcement, and the eventual decay of herding as complementary mechanisms behind momentum and reversal.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究构建了一个基于代理的金融市场模型，通过局部从众行为和信息延迟传播的联合效应来解释股票价格的动量和反转现象。投资者对下一期价格持有异质的高斯信念，会在买入、卖出或保持观望之间做出选择，并根据周围投资者的行为调整自己的行动概率。模型中的局部互动结构最初采用冯·诺伊曼-摩尔格子（von Neumann and Moore lattices）进行表示，为增强模型的鲁棒性，后续改用了埃尔德什-雷尼（Erdős–Rényi）和瓦茨-斯特罗加茨（Watts–Strogatz）网络。另一个独立的信息处理过程通过有限速度的扩散机制更新投资者的信念，从而将信息调整与行为模仿区分开来。模拟结果表明，较强的从众行为会导致交易行为在空间上聚集、价格波动加剧以及收益率的超额峰度（kurtosis）更加明显。较快的信息传播速度可以缩短价格收敛到信号所预示价值所需的时间；而信息传播与社会强化机制的结合则会导致价格过度波动后出现反转。通过对中国A股市场的实证分析，将传统的CSAD和LSV指标与经过约翰逊$S_U$变换得到的基于滚动尾部的从众指数进行了比较，发现这些指标在市场大幅波动期间表现出相似的时间变化趋...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Forcing and duality-corrected contracts for volatility control
papers.abstract: In this paper, we revisit the construction of optimal incentives in continuous-time principal-agent problems with drift and volatility control. Originally, a general approach relying on dynamic programming and second-order backward stochastic differential equations (2BSDEs) was developed by Cvitanić, Possamaï, and Touzi (2018) [8] to determine the optimal form of contracts in this setting. More recently, Chiusolo and Hubert (2026) [5] proposed a BSDE-based approach by introducing an alternative `contractible-volatility' problem for the principal. In addition to the proposed new method, this work highlights that the optimality result of [8] actually hinges on an assumption, stated below as Assumption 2.3, which may not hold in general. Motivated by this, we introduce in this paper a more general class of contracts, parametrised by a function $ψ$ subject to conditions that make the contract revealing for the agent and without loss of generality for the principal. We further provide two natural specifications of $ψ$: one, inspired by the BSDE approach, yielding a forcing-type contract; the other, motivated by the 2BSDE approach, correcting the duality gap when Assumption 2.3 is not satisfied.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在本文中，我们重新探讨了具有漂移和波动性控制的连续时间委托-代理问题中最优激励的构建问题。最初，Cvitanić、Possamaï和Touzi（2018年）[8]提出了一种基于动态规划和二阶向后随机微分方程（2BSDEs）的通用方法，用于确定此类环境下的最优合约形式。最近，Chiusolo和Hubert（2026年）[5]提出了一种基于BSDE的方法，为委托人引入了一个替代的“可压缩波动性”问题。除了这种新方法外，本文还指出，[8]中的最优性结果实际上依赖于一个假设（如下所述的假设2.3），而该假设在一般情况下可能并不成立。受此启发，我们在本文中引入了一类更通用的合约，这类合约由函数ψ参数化，并满足一些条件，以确保合约对代理人具有信息揭示作用，同时对委托人来说也是通用的。我们进一步给出了ψ的两种自然表述方式：一种受到BSDE方法的启发，产生了一种强制型合约；另一种则受到2BSDE方法的启发，用于在假设2.3不成立时纠正对偶性差距。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Multi-Asset Liquidation in Dark Pools with Adverse Selection
papers.abstract: Multi-asset liquidation in dark pools with adverse selection remains unsolved in literature. In this paper, we investigate multi-asset portfolio liquidation in dark pools with quadratic adverse selection cost by analyzing a multidimensional stochastic control problem, which leads to a matrix-valued BSDE with jumps and a singular terminal condition. Beyond establishing the existence of a solution, our key contribution lies in proving uniqueness, a result that is novel even in simplified settings and strengthens existing findings in the literature. In the two-asset case, we further examine the interaction between asset correlation and adverse selection. On the one hand, we find that the protection of a well-diversified portfolio is not determined by adverse selection but rather by the spillover effects of dark-pool orders. On the other hand, we show that the primary role of adverse selection is to determine whether a poorly diversified portfolio can be rescued through dark-pool trading.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在文献中，关于存在逆向选择情况下的暗池多资产清算问题尚未得到解决。在本文中，我们通过分析一个多维随机控制问题，研究了存在二次逆向选择成本的暗池多资产投资组合清算问题。该问题导致了一个包含跳跃项的矩阵值随机微分方程（BSDE）以及一个奇异的终端条件。我们的主要贡献不仅在于证明了该问题的解的存在性，还证明了解的唯一性——这一结果即使在简化条件下也是新颖的，并且进一步加强了现有文献中的研究结果。在两资产情形下，我们进一步探讨了资产相关性与逆向选择之间的相互作用。一方面，我们发现一个多元化程度较高的投资组合是否能够得到保护，并非由逆向选择决定，而是由暗池订单的溢出效应所决定；另一方面，我们表明逆向选择的主要作用在于判断一个多元化程度较低的投资组合是否可以通过暗池交易得到挽救。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: A Simple Robust Procedure in Instrumental Variables Regression
papers.abstract: A common concern in empirical modelling centres around whether estimated regression coefficients are affected by a small set of outlying observations. To conduct outlier robustness checks in practical applications of instrumental variables regressions, the common practice is to run ordinary two stage least squares (2SLS) and remove observations with standardised residuals beyond a chosen cut-off value. Subsequently, the trimmed 2SLS is computed and compared to the original full-sample 2SLS. This paper aims to understand and improve the above heuristic procedure by establishing an asymptotic theory. Specifically, there are three main contributions of the paper. First, the trimmed 2SLS has a positive probability of removing observations even under the null hypothesis where the model contains no outliers. Under this situation, we derive a limiting Normal distribution of the trimmed 2SLS with the asymptotic variance as the ordinary one multiplied by a relative efficiency inflator. Furthermore, a bias correction factor is introduced for the variance estimator of structural errors, which otherwise would be downward biased. Second, a Hausman-type test is constructed to formalize the heuristic procedure of comparing between the two 2SLS estimators. Third, the trimmed 2SLS is a two-step procedure, which can be iterated until a fixed point is reached. The fixed point is shown to have the same first order asymptotics as the Huber-skip M-estimator. Our analysis involves a new class of empirical processes, whose theory would be of independent interest in applied probability. Simulation studies lend support to the asymptotic theory. An empirical illustration to Acemoglu et al. (2019) shows the utility of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在实证建模中，一个常见的关注点是估计的回归系数是否受到少数异常观测值的影响。在实际应用工具变量回归时，通常的做法是先进行普通的两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）估计，然后剔除标准化残差超过预设阈值的观测值。随后，计算剔除异常值后的2SLS估计结果，并将其与原始的全样本2SLS结果进行比较。本文旨在通过建立渐近理论来理解和改进这一经验性处理方法。具体而言，本文有三个主要贡献：首先，即使在模型中不存在异常值的原假设下，剔除异常值的2SLS方法也有较大的概率能够正确地剔除这些观测值。在这种情况下，我们推导出了剔除异常值后2SLS的极限分布，其渐近方差为普通2SLS方差的乘以一个相对效率调整因子。此外，本文还引入了一个偏差校正因子，用于修正结构误差的方差估计量（否则该估计量会存在向下偏差）。其次，构建了一个Hausman型检验，以正式化比较两种2SLS估计量的方法。第三，剔除异常值的2SLS方法是一个两步过程，可以迭代进行直到达到一个稳定状态；该稳定状态的一阶渐近性质与Huber-skip M估计量相同。我们的分析涉及一类新的实证过程，其理论在应用概率学领域具有独立的研究价值。模拟研究结果支持...。研究方法：工具变量、两阶段最小二乘、回归分析、数值模拟。

papers.title: No Data Is Not No Risk: Visibility Aware Graph-Based Inference of Business Conduct Risk
papers.abstract: The monitoring of business conduct risk is hindered by sparse, uneven, and visibility-biased data. Prior studies show that business conduct risk information and media coverage propagate through supply chain, peer, and corporate structure networks, yet incident records remain incomplete for many firms. As a result, the absence of reported events could reflect limited coverage rather than the absence of underlying business conduct risk. This paper examines whether inter-firm relationships can improve the prediction of future recorded conduct related incidents, particularly among firms with limited prior visibility. We formulate the task as Positive--Unlabeled node classification on a corporate ownership graph, where firms with recorded incidents are treated as labeled positives and firms without recorded incidents remain unlabeled. We then propose a visibility- and relation-aware GCNII framework that combines relation specific message passing with non-negative Positive--Unlabeled learning to account for positive contamination in the unlabeled set. In a forward-looking evaluation, the proposed approach achieved the strongest observed ranking performance relative to non-graph- and simple graph-based benchmarks. The results further show that graph-based inference retains its predictive value among firms without prior recorded incidents. These findings demonstrate the value of inter-firm relational structure as a complementary source of information for extending risk prioritization
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】对企业行为风险的监控受到数据稀疏、分布不均以及数据可见性偏差的阻碍。先前的研究表明，企业行为风险信息及媒体报道会通过供应链、同行网络和企业结构网络进行传播，但许多企业的事件记录仍然不完整。因此，未记录的事件可能并非真正意味着这些企业不存在行为风险，而只是因为报道不足所致。本文探讨了企业间关系是否能够提高对未来可能发生的行为相关事件的预测能力，尤其是对于那些此前关注度较低的企业。我们将该问题定义为在企业所有权图上的“正样本-未标记节点分类”问题：其中，发生过事件的企业被视为已标记的“正样本”，而未发生过事件的企业则保持未标记状态。为此，我们提出了一种考虑数据可见性和企业间关系的GCNII（Graph-Centered Neural Inference with Visibility and Relations）框架，该框架结合了针对特定关系的信息传递机制与非负学习算法，以有效处理未标记样本中的“正样本干扰”现象。在前瞻性评估中，所提出的方法在性能上显著优于非图基方法和简单的图基基准模型。研究结果还表明，基于图的推理方法在那些此前未发生过事件的企业中依然具有预测价值。这些发现凸显了企...。

papers.title: Crossing-Free Probabilistic K-Line Forecasts Without Retraining
papers.abstract: Probabilistic K-line forecasting describes uncertainty in four complementary prices, namely open--high--low--close (OHLC). However, it introduces two consistency problems: quantile crossing and K-line crossing. Quantile crossing occurs when a higher-quantile forecast falls below a lower-quantile forecast, while K-line crossing occurs when the forecast low exceeds the open or close, or the forecast high falls below the open or close. Existing solutions generally address only one problem through output reordering, specialized architectures, or penalized training objectives. We propose K-line--Quantile Sequential Projection (KQSP), a parameter-free and training-free reconciliation method applicable to forecasts produced by any model. Compared with other crossing solutions, KQSP preserves predictive accuracy while producing substantially smaller corrections to the original forecasts. To mitigate model bias, we evaluate KQSP using various models, including pretrained foundation models. KQSP reduces both quantile and K-line crossing rates to zero for all test data undertaken. These results show that probabilistic K-line consistency can be enforced independently of forecast generation and without retraining.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】概率K线预测方法用于处理四种互补价格数据（即开盘价、最高价、最低价和收盘价，OHLC）的不确定性。然而，该方法存在两个一致性问题：分位数交叉和K线交叉。分位数交叉指的是高分位数预测结果低于低分位数预测结果的情况；而K线交叉则发生在预测的最低价超过开盘价或收盘价，或者预测的最高价低于开盘价或收盘价时。现有的解决方法通常通过重新排序输出数据、采用特定架构或设置惩罚性训练目标来仅解决其中一个问题。我们提出了一种名为K线-分位数序列投影（KQSP）的无参数、无需训练的协调方法，该方法适用于任何模型生成的预测结果。与其他解决交叉问题的方法相比，KQSP在保持预测准确性的同时，对原始预测结果的修正幅度显著较小。为了减少模型偏差，我们使用包括预训练基础模型在内的多种模型对KQSP进行了评估。结果表明，KQSP能够将所有测试数据中的分位数交叉和K线交叉率降至零。这些实验结果表明，概率K线预测的一致性可以在不依赖于预测生成过程且无需重新训练的情况下得到保障。。
